description: One data row of central/people.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8.

attrs.description: JSON object of the person's kept attributes.

cost_center.description: Cost centre of the person or unit, from the organisation files.

function.description: Function of the person or unit, from the organisation files.

level.description: Level of the person, from the organisation files.

manager_key.description: person_key of the person's manager on the attribution day.

person_key.description: Pseudonymous person key: a keyed hash of the person id, stable for one hashing key.

population.description: Population label of the person, from the organisation files.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

unit_id.description: Organisation unit id from the organisation files.

valid_from.description: First day the row is valid.

valid_to.description: Last day the row is valid; empty if open.

title: gold-dataset-people
x-grain: One row per person and validity period.
